content_fields.title: Test that user-supplied inputs are validated before being passed to OS commands
content_fields.description: Remove the shell from the execution path and constrain the argument to a validated value.
content_fields.finding: The `parameters` string is concatenated onto "df -h " and executed with shell=True, giving direct command injection.
criteria: The command is passed as an argument list.
The only variable part is drawn from a closed enum, never from a free-form string.
A request with `parameters=/; id` returns 422 and executes nothing.
